decision: GO for isolated implementation, with the corrections and exact-source gates below. This is not approval to launch or submit.
hypothesis: Two independently advancing 320-thread CTAs per SM may hide producer/consumer latency better than one 576-thread CTA, preserving logical weight bytes and token-job partition.

withdrawn_pdl_finding.status: WITHDRAWN after root checked the CUDA specification and critic independently verified it.
withdrawn_pdl_finding.initial_claim_retained_for_audit: The parent calls griddepcontrol.launch_dependents before its grid barrier. The critic initially claimed that, under compact two-CTA residency, a successor CTA could occupy space before all parent CTAs had entered and cause an admission cycle.
withdrawn_pdl_finding.why_incorrect: CUDA Programming Guide 4.5.2 states that a secondary kernel under cudaLaunchAttributeProgrammaticStreamSerialization can launch only after all primary blocks have launched and executed the trigger. Thus the claimed successor-before-unadmitted-parent cycle is not possible under this launch contract.
withdrawn_pdl_finding.corrected_action: Restore and retain the parent's launch_dependents placement. No additional PDL relocation is justified by the withdrawn finding. Retain the initial griddepcontrol.wait and all required release/acquire ordering.

required_static_gates: Actual packed-byte bijection and all scale bytes recovered for full W13/W2 experts; unchanged non-WGS encodings and fallback AST.
Both gather branches cover every row's two chunks per thread before the xready release.
All NTT1..8 WGMMA descriptor addresses remain within K128 by padded-token storage.
Joined full barriers receive two producer arrivals and all expected bytes; empty barriers use the actual eight consumer warps.
All doneAs allocations, accesses, waits and resets use 32 counters per job and readiness count four; per-warpgroup publication occurs after stores and the required barrier.
Stream-K fixups use 32-stage completion counts, two warpgroup slots per boundary, capacity at least actual grid plus one, and disjoint correctly aligned buffers.
Exact overflow-safe range partition and inverse ownership across nearby route counts, maximum chunks and repeated jobs.
Zero-local-job execution must set empty ranges without binary-searching an absent job or dividing by zero.

Actual compiled specialization occupancy must allow at least two blocks per SM before launching the full resident grid; unsupported resources fail rather than silently validating a different one-CTA experiment.
performance_counterarguments: Two compact CTAs still have four compute warpgroups per SM in total, the same as the parent.
Producer warps double; per-SM packed weight-ring capacity halves from 110592 to 55296 bytes, while activation-ring capacity stays 98304 bytes.
Output units double, so logical activation requests increase even though logical packed-weight bytes stay unchanged. Actual DRAM traffic is unknown.
Streaming final normalization rereads ybuf and changes FP32 reduction order; it may lose the latency benefit and requires numerical validation.
More stage events, fixups and uncalibrated relative cost estimates can offset independent CTA progress.
next_gate: Independent exact-source and CPU proof review before root considers one official private check. Do not score on resource fit, fewer instructions, or theoretical occupancy alone.
